descripcion_geo: Lakeside city of Galilee, between Tiberias and Capernaum. Fishing and commercial center; also known as Taricheae by the Romans.
importancia_estrategica: Birthplace of Mary Magdalene; scene of an appearance of Jesus in the lake.

historias.descripcion: After the multiplication of the loaves, Jesus crosses the lake and reaches the region of Magadan.

historias.titulo: Mary Magdalene, the first witness of the resurrection
historias.descripcion: Mary of Magdala was the first person to whom the resurrected Jesus appeared; She gives the news to the apostles.
Modern excavations have revealed a 1st century synagogue at Magdala with a unique stone depicting the Temple of Jerusalem.

personajes.rol: Disciple and first witness of the resurrection
personajes.descripcion: Freed from seven demons by Jesus; witness of the crucifixion, burial and first appearance of the resurrected one.
He visited Magdala and appeared to Mary there after the resurrection.
One of the Galilean women who followed Jesus, possibly from the Magdala region.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Galilee Lake Fishing Town; birthplace of Mary Magdalene, a central figure in the Easter narrative.

mitos.nombre: Mary Magdalene and the Garden of the Resurrection

cristianismo.descripcion: Mary Magdalene, called by name by the Risen One in the garden, is the first apostolic testimony of the resurrection.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Mary Magdalene, called by name by the Risen One in the garden, is the first apostolic testimony of the resurrection.

historias.descripcion: After the second multiplication of the loaves, Jesus arrives in the region of Magadan (Dalmanuta in Mark).

historias.titulo: Mary Magdalene: witness of the resurrection
historias.descripcion: Jesus first appears to Mary Magdalene in the garden; she announces it to the apostles.

historias.titulo: Galilean women in the ministry of Jesus
historias.descripcion: A group of women, including Mary Magdalene of Magdala, financially supported Jesus's ministry.

personajes.descripcion: Freed from seven demons; witness to the crucifixion and the empty tomb; first to see the Risen One.
He appeared first to Mary Magdalene.
Galilean woman who supported the ministry of Jesus; witness of the resurrection.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Magdala is the homeland of the first witness to the resurrection.

cristianismo.descripcion: Mary of Magdala was the first person to whom the Risen Lord appeared; Their testimony is the foundation of the Easter faith.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Mary of Magdala was the first person to whom the Risen Lord appeared; Their testimony is the foundation of the Easter faith.
